explainer: Defines correct package-owned locations for Tab 9 prompt-library assets.
how_it_works: The rules prevent an AI from placing Tab 9 package assets under excluded reference folders or unrelated source boxes.
risks: Assets may be placed under project_freeze_ledger or _project_reference and become invisible to the package-owned Tab 9 library.
mitigations: The rules name the correct package-owned folders and the incorrect legacy folders.
safe_usage: Use when asking an AI to place or relocate prompt-library assets.
example_usage: Copy this file with the authoring guide when asking another AI to create prompt-library assets.
